items.title: Qual é a diferença entre os modelos Muse Wonder, Muse Spark e Muse Ember?
items.pt:
A Meta desenvolveu três modelos de inteligência artificial da família Muse, cada um pensado para um tipo de tarefa. O Muse Wonder é indicado para atividades complexas, que exigem raciocínio e planejamento, e o Muse Spark atende às interações do dia a dia com a assistente Meta AI. Já o Muse Ember foi criado para executar tarefas repetitivas com rapidez e baixo custo.
Os três modelos fazem parte do trabalho do Meta Superintelligence Labs (MSL), divisão da empresa dedicada ao desenvolvimento de IA

A Black Friday é uma das melhores épocas para procurar uma TV nova, mas nem todo desconto anunciado representa uma economia real. Isso vale especialmente para modelos de 55 polegadas, que aparecem em diferentes tecnologias de tela e faixas de preço.

items.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
items.pt: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch.

items.title: TGScope is hiring: four remote research contracts (search, network science, internet measurement, data journalism)
items.pt:
TGScope is an independent R&D lab and Telegram search engine. We index 3 million public channels, run multilingual semantic search and an interactive map on top of them, and publish research on the Telegram ecosystem: channel networks, reach, post statistics and access restrictions.

We have four project-based contracts open. Each runs for about two months, is fully remote and is paid by the hour.


  
  
  Research Engineer, Multilingual Semantic Search


The project: build a relevance benchmar

items.title: How to Prepare an Annual Review: Guide for Managers
items.pt:
If you want to prepare an annual review well, you usually start too late. The pattern is familiar: in November an invitation from HR lands in your inbox, the date gets closer, and the evening before you sit in front of an empty form trying to reconstruct twelve months from memory. What comes out is mostly what happened in the last six weeks. That is human, but it is unfair to the person sitting across from you.

items.pt: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. items.title: Internalizing Investment Mandates: A Neurosymbolic RL Approach to Portfolio Allocation
